painted.style: A hand-painted bust portrait of one fantasy RPG character for a dialogue window. Stylised Japanese fantasy RPG character art (not realistic): the character design of a 2.6 to 2.8 heads tall character, so a large head relative to the shoulders, large clear expressive eyes with simple bright highlights, a simplified small nose and small mouth, smooth rounded cheeks and a soft rounded face shape, as in the attached pixel-art face. Older characters keep exactly this stylisation, shown only with a few gentle wrinkle lines, never realistic skin detail. Framing (identical for every character so heads match in size): head and shoulders down to mid-chest; the face from eyebrows to chin about 22% of the image height, the eyes at about 40% of the image height from the top, the head horizontally near the centre; the whole head, hair and any hat or headwear fully inside the image with empty background above it (at least 6% margin at the top edge, more if the hair or hat is tall; never cut off spikes, feathers or hat brims). Pose: body and face turned slightly to the viewer's left (a soft three-quarter view facing left), eyes looking in the same direction as the face (slightly to the left). Rendering: rich painterly digital illustration, visible soft brushwork, clean readable shapes and silhouettes, painted (not lined like a comic, not photographic, not 3D, not pixel art). Lighting: warm lamp light from the front left lighting the face, and a cool blue moonlight rim light along the right edge of the hair and shoulders. Calm, moderately saturated colours, gentle contrast. Background: plain flat dark navy (#141a2c) with only a very faint soft vignette; no scenery, no props in the background, no frame, no border, no text, no letters, no signature, no watermark.

exprs.neutral: Expression: calm, neutral, attentive; mouth closed.
exprs.smile: Expression: a warm, soft smile; eyes slightly narrowed with kindness; cheeks lifted a little.
exprs.sad: Expression: sad; inner ends of the eyebrows raised and drawn together, eyes lowered and slightly glistening, mouth corners turned down a little.
exprs.angry: Expression: stern anger; eyebrows drawn down and together, a firm frown, eyes narrowed and intense, mouth pressed tight.
exprs.surprise: Expression: surprise; eyes wide open, eyebrows raised high, mouth slightly open in a small round shape.

looks.berna: An elderly kindly village storyteller woman of about seventy: long straight silver-white hair parted in the middle falling past the shoulders, a dark moss-green headscarf covering the top of the head and tied at the back with the knot and tails visible behind her head, warm brown eyes, a soft round face with gentle wrinkles and smile lines, fair warm skin. A dark moss-green long dress; over the shoulders a rough undyed beige wool shawl with a fringed edge; a necklace of round amber-brown wooden beads with a small brass bell pendant at the chest; a brown cloth sash at the waist (may be just out of frame). No glasses.
looks.fine: A slender young woman who looks about seventeen, an ancient storyteller bound into legend, quiet and slightly melancholic: pale skin, long wavy pale silver-ash blonde hair framing the face and falling over the chest, grey-blue eyes. She wears a slate blue-grey hooded travel cloak with the hood up over her head, the hood edge trimmed with a thin line of small cream beads or embroidery; a cream inner tunic; at the throat a small round bronze clasp with cords. A very faint pale luminous softness at the edges of her hair suggests she is slowly fading, kept subtle.
looks.rowell: A young man of about twenty, a serious and proud scholar-knight of an archive institute: untidy spiky dark charcoal-grey hair with fringe falling over the forehead and a short tied tail at the nape, dark grey eyes, fair pale skin with a cool light tone (not tanned, not orange), a composed slightly cool face. He wears a white high-collared uniform coat with gold trim on the collar and a diagonal placket closed with round gold buttons, a small silver quill-shaped pin on the left side of the chest, a dark leather belt with a gold buckle at the bottom edge. No glasses.
looks.lazaro: An elderly dignified scholar-priest of about seventy: silver-white hair combed straight back in neat grooves, a short neat white beard and moustache, kind tired brown eyes, fair skin. A cream-white high-collared robe with silver-grey embroidered trim and a pale blue-grey inner lining at the shoulder.
looks.noa: A gentle young woman of about twenty: long chestnut-brown hair with a loose side braid over her right shoulder and a small white flower in her hair, brown eyes, fair skin, soft kind face. A mustard-orange dress with short puffed sleeves trimmed with cream fur, a cream apron, a small wooden bird charm at the chest.
looks.npc_jorn: A sturdy northern man of about forty: blond-brown hair and a short full golden-brown beard, stern blue-grey eyes, ruddy fair skin. A green fur-lined trapper hat with cream fur ear flaps, a green winter coat with thick cream fur collar, a green and gold patterned belt.
looks.npc_kaya: A young desert woman of about twenty-five: dark brown hair wrapped up high in a dark turban-like wrap with a small gold and red jewel ornament at the front, warm brown eyes, deep brown skin, gold earrings. A deep red and orange patterned shawl wrapped over a dark top, gold brooch at the shoulder.
looks.npc_pim: A small cheerful boy of about ten: messy light brown hair under a round brown woven straw cap, big brown eyes, fair skin. A leaf-green tunic jacket with ragged edges, a cream shirt, a small cross pendant, a brown satchel strap.
looks.npc_rashid: A desert guide man of about thirty-five: a dark brown turban with a white-and-brown feather tucked in it, a dark brown face veil covering his nose and mouth, sharp dark eyes, deep brown skin. Layered dark brown desert robes with fur trim, a round bronze ornament on the chest, a curved dagger hilt at the shoulder.
looks.npc_tadeo: A stocky jovial travelling merchant of about forty-five: short dark hair under a dark blue knit cap, a big bushy brown moustache, round cheeks, brown eyes, fair skin. A dark navy coat with leather straps and buckles, a canvas apron, a big backpack strap, a small brass teapot hanging at his chest.
looks.npc_yena: A calm young woman of about twenty-five: shoulder-length dark grey-black hair tied in a low ponytail, grey eyes, pale fair skin. A plain light grey hooded robe with the hood down, a small white paper tag hanging at the chest.
looks.npc_zaid: A middle-aged desert elder of about fifty-five: a dark blue turban, a short grey beard and moustache, tired dark eyes, brown skin. A sand-beige robe with a dark blue scarf and blue sash, a small brass key at the belt.
looks.npc_zakuro: A disciplined soldier of about thirty: very short grey buzz-cut hair, serious dark eyes and dark eyebrows, deep brown skin. Grey steel plate armour over the shoulders and chest with a small white name plate, brown leather straps and belt.
looks.otto: An elderly sea captain of about sixty-five: white hair and a full white beard, stern blue eyes, weathered fair skin. A navy-blue captain's cap and a navy double-breasted coat with brass buttons, holding a small brass lantern near his chest.
looks.bartolo: An old veteran knight of about sixty-five: a steel visored helmet with the visor up and a blue plume, thick white eyebrows and a huge white moustache, fierce eyes, fair skin. Polished steel plate armour, a blue scarf, a sword hilt over his shoulder.
looks.basil: A gentle heavy-set monk of about thirty-five: balding with short brown hair at the sides, round friendly face, brown eyes, fair skin. A sage-green hooded robe with the hood down and a large necklace of big round wooden prayer beads.
looks.belladonna: A young herbalist woman of about twenty-five: long dark green-black hair under a wrapped cream turban, half-closed calm brown eyes, fair skin, a small earring. looks.brigitta: A young woman soldier of about twenty-five: auburn-brown hair in a long braid, a grey steel kettle helmet with a small star emblem, brown eyes, fair skin, determined face. A blue tunic with a steel shoulder pauldron, a leather strap across the chest.
looks.dokka: A short burly dwarf smith of about fifty: bald head with a few scars, bushy dark eyebrows, a huge dark brown beard in two thick braids with iron rings, fierce eyes, ruddy skin. looks.ferno: A charming wandering bard of about thirty: curly auburn-brown shoulder-length hair, a small goatee, warm brown eyes, fair skin.
